dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: Don't mind me... I won't be around much longer anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: There's no need for you to know. Just leave me alone for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anyone looking after you?

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. Who'd want a nagging old man weighing him down anyway? It's not like he's my own flesh and blood...

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: *Sigh* Why did he have to go hunting so far out? It's not like I would've starved to death without a bite of meat...

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: I'm on my deathbed anyway, what difference does it make? Dragging me to a place like this...

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: He should've just let me freeze to death in my old house. At least there'd be no need to bother with a coffin. The place was good enough for me — not like I've got anyone to leave it to anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like me to go get Alyosha?

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: No, no! Anything but that. Have you ever seen anyone kidnap an old man with a hunting net?

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: Dragged me all the way here just because he insisted I might live a few days longer...
